$comment: Real, freely licensed photographs. Source of truth for scripts/sync-photos.mjs. Only 'commons' titles are accepted; licence, author and URLs are pulled from Wikimedia Commons, never typed by hand. kind 'place' = venue/city; kind 'event' = people at a real conference, which must name that event in 'event' and in the caption. No photo here shows the summit or its 2025 edition: add real summit photos only when the convener supplies them.
